Forwarding Novus' redlines and my consolidated notes. Quick summary below and the redline PDF is attached.

Summary (MSA):
- Data handling / customer data: Novus proposes a shorter retention period in section 4 — proposed response: offer configurable retention term in the order form; add a clause for data deletion on termination within 30 days.
- Liability cap: Novus wants higher cap tied to first-year fees; proposed response: standard cap of 3x fees unless customer provides an exception case; flag to commercial for escalation if needed.
- Subprocessors: Novus asked for a list of subprocessors and 30-day notice of changes — we can provide a current list and commit to notice.
- Audit rights / SOC 2 evidence: they requested a copy of our SOC 2 Type II — I suggest sending the summary report and a contact for our auditor; full report on NDA.

Action items from Legal (owners & ETA):
- Monica: consolidated redline PDF to Claire by EOD today (2027-04-09).
- Karthik: confirm pricing language that allows the 30-day retention configuration in the order form by COB Monday (2027-04-12).
- Marcus: confirm the vendor onboarding attributes Novus needs (tenant id, contact, IP allowlist options) by Monday morning (2027-04-12).

Notes: Please review the proposed liability language — I flagged two clauses that may need commercial signoff.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
